# gws CLI: Google Chat reference

💳 Curated by Skill Harbor — the full Google Chat API v1 reference for the `gws` CLI: spaces, messages, members, users, media upload/download and custom emojis, with the `gws schema` discovery workflow before any call. The first Chat fiche in the catalog — the 9 gws fiches of lot 33 cover Calendar, Tasks, Slides, Forms, Meet and Keep only, and the lot 31 googleworkspace fiches are workflows/personas, not CLI references. Its `+send` companion is listed separately as `googleworkspace-cli-gws-chat-send`, mirroring the lot 33 `gws-calendar` / `gws-calendar-agenda` + `gws-calendar-insert` pattern. By @googleworkspace, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: requires the `gws` binary and a Google account (browser OAuth is free; the Chat API generally needs a paid Google Workspace account, and custom emojis need an admin to enable them); install the prerequisite `googleworkspace-cli-gws-shared` first. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
